url.title: JSON APIs: Air v11 Online Help
url.keywords: JSON, Airv11, Air v11, JSON APIs
url.description: Help for JSON API Air v11

url.title: JSON APIs: NDC Guide
url.keywords: NDC, New Distribution Capability, NDC carriers, NDC support
url.description: This guide discusses general NDC support in the JSON APIs and high-level differences by API.

url.title: JSON APIs: Authentication
url.keywords: OAuth, JSON APIs authentication, authentication, credentials
url.description: All Travelport JSON APIs require authentication with OAuth 2.0. Before calling any API, you must follow an OAuth-based authorization procedure to obtain an access token, and then provide that access token with every call.

url.title: JSON APIs: Search API
url.keywords: Air Search, Search, catalogproductofferings, passengerTypeCode, SearchModifiersAir, search modifiers
url.description: The Search API is the first step in the travel booking workflow. Send a Search request to return offers for flights between the selected cities.

url.title: JSON APIs: Next Leg Search API
url.keywords: Air Search, buildnext, CatalogProductOfferingsQueryBuildNext, build next
url.description: Use the Next Leg Search API to return offers for the remaining leg/s of an itinerary after a leg-based Search. A leg-based Search response returns offers for only the outbound leg of your itinerary, and you must send Next Leg Search to return offers for the remaining leg or legs of the trip.

url.title: JSON APIs: Air APIs Endpoints
url.keywords: endpoints, JSON APIs endpoints
url.description: A consolidated list of endpoints and associated methods for all v11 Air APIs.

url.title: JSON APIs: Flight Specific Search Reference Payload
url.keywords: Air Search, ProductIdentifier, reference payload, upsells
url.description: Use the Flight Specific Search API reference payload request to return additional upsells (you can set up to 99) for any product or products returned by a Search or Next Leg Search. The reference payload sends an identifier referencing a previous response and the offer and product identifiers. Supported for both GDS and NDC.

url.title: JSON APIs: Flight Specific Search Full Payload
url.keywords: Air Search, full payload, buildoptions, upsells
url.description: Use the Flight Specific Search API's full payload request to return additional upsells (you can set up to 99) for one or more flights.

url.title: JSON APIs: AirPrice Reference Payload
url.keywords: Price, Air Price, buildfromcatalogproductofferings, lowFareFinderInd, returnBrandedFaresInd, pricing modifiers
url.description: The AirPrice API confirms pricing on air search results. While air pricing is generally an optional but recommended step, it is required for low cost carriers and some NDC carriers.

url.title: JSON APIs: AirPrice Full Payload API Reference
url.keywords: Air Price, Price, buildfromproducts, full payload, BuildFromProductsRequest, OfferQueryBuildFromProducts
url.description: The AirPrice API confirms pricing on air search results. While air pricing is generally an optional but recommended step, it is required for low cost carriers and some NDC carriers. This API reference documents the full payload request, which sends full itinerary details without a reference to any previous search. This request can be used to price an itinerary returned from the Search API or from a non-Travelport source.

url.title: JSON APIs: Full Brand Pricing API Reference
url.keywords: brand content, buildcompleteinfofromoffer, Air Price, Price, BrandQueryBuildCompleteInfoFromOffer, OfferIdentifier, ProductIdentifier
url.description: The full brand pricing request is a follow-on request to air pricing that returns any additional content for the branded fares returned. All attributes associated with that branded fare are returned along with any additional details available, such as beverages, mileage accrual, etc. If brand details are not available for that market, no additional details are returned. The full brand pricing request can be sent after either an AirPrice reference payload request or an AirPrice full payload request , as long as the request sent returnBrandedFaresInd set to true to return brand attributes.

url.title: JSON APIs: Fare Rules API Reference
url.keywords: fare rules, farerules, offerIdentifier, fareRuleType, fareRuleCategories
url.description: Fare rules are the conditions and restrictions that apply to any booking based on its fare type. These determine the price of the fare. Generally, less expensive fares have more restrictions and more expensive fares have fewer restrictions. Fare rules can include blackout dates, advanced reservation requirements, minimum and maximum stay requirements, and cancellation and change penalties.

url.title: JSON APIs: New Workbench API Reference
url.keywords: session, reservationworkbench, ReservationID, work bench, workbench identifier
url.description: Use this request to initiate a workbench for a new reservation. This prerequisite step for booking creates the workbench session in which all booking details are added together to create a reservation at commit.

url.title: JSON APIs: Post-Commit Workbench API Reference
url.keywords: booking, session, reservationworkbench, work bench, workbench, LocatorCode, Locator
url.description: Initiate a post-commit workbench to create a session for ticketing or updating an existing reservation. This is a prerequisite step for any transaction that modifies, updates, or tickets any reservation.

url.title: JSON APIs: Retrieve Workbench API Reference
url.keywords: workbench, work bench, workbenchID
url.description: At any point in the booking session, you can retrieve the workbench. The response returns all details added to the workbench at that point.

url.title: JSON APIs: Discard Workbench API Reference
url.keywords: DEL, workbenchID, work bench
url.description: At any point in a booking or ticketing workflow, if necessary, you can discard the workbench and any information in it.

url.title: JSON APIs: Workbench Commit API Reference
url.keywords: booking, session, workbenchID, work bench
url.description: After all required and any optional steps in a booking workbench session, send a POST request with the workbench identifier to commit the workbench.

url.title: JSON APIs: Add Offer Reference Payload API Reference
url.keywords: booking, reservationworkbench, buildfromcatalogofferings, add offer, OfferQueryBuildFromCatalogProductOfferings
url.description: Use the Add Offer reference payload request to add an offer to the reservation workbench as part of the booking workflow. The reference payload request sends identifiers from the Search response instead of full itinerary details.

url.title: JSON APIs: Add Offer Full Payload API Reference
url.keywords: booking, reservationworkbench, buildfromproducts, OfferQueryBuildFromProducts, add offer
url.description: Use the Add Offer full payload request to add an offer to the reservation workbench as part of the booking workflow. The full payload request sends full itinerary details instead of identifiers from the Search response as in the reference payload request.

url.title: JSON APIs: Add Traveler API Reference
url.keywords: traveler, traveller, passengerTypeCode, TravelerRef, Address, PassengerCriteria, frequent flyer, CustomerLoyalty, Customer Loyalty, TravelDocument, Travel Document
url.description: Send the Add Traveler request to add a traveler to the reservation workbench. You must add each traveler to the workbench in a separate POST request. Traveler information can include traveler name and contact details, add traveler-specific remarks including certain SSRs and travel documents such as a passport.

url.title: JSON APIs: Remarks and Service Requests Guide and API Reference
url.keywords: remarks, comments, traveler document, SSR, DOCO, DOCS, FOID, form of ID, CHLD, CTCE, CTCM, CTCR, meal request, comment, OSI, document override remarks, accounting remarks, India GST
url.description: The JSON APIs support several types of comments and optional service requests. Some, such as travel document details and client delivery comments, are sent in the Add Traveler payload and can only be added in the initial booking workflow. Others are sent in a separate payload either during the initial booking workflow, or you can add them to an existing reservation. This combined guide and API reference provides the endpoint, payload, and examples for all comments and optional service requests. Each section notes whether the reservation retrieve returns that information.

url.title: JSON APIs: Reservation Retrieve API Reference
url.keywords: booking, LocatorCode, reservation, retrieve, fareRuleRetrievalType
url.description: Retrieve details about a held booking, or reservation. While a reservation refers to a held booking that has not been ticketed, the reservation code persists after ticketing to provide the booking records. Once a reservation has been ticketed, you can still use Reservation Retrieve to return both booking and ticketing details.

url.title: JSON APIs: Traveler Updatable Items API Reference
url.keywords: traveler, traveller, update traveler, change traveler name, updatableitem, TravelerUpdatableItemsQueryBuildFromTraveler
url.description: The Updatable Items request retrieves by traveler ID a list of objects that are updatable for that traveler, and returns for each an indicator for whether that item can be added, modified, or deleted.

url.title: JSON APIs: Ancillary Shop API Reference
url.keywords: paid baggage, ancillary, ancillaries, ancillaryshop, CatalogOfferingsQueryAncillaries, AncillaryOfferings
url.description: The Ancillary Shop request searches for ancillaries available for the reservation. You must first create a new or post-commit workbench. After ancillary shop, send an ancillary price request (only for NDC), and then add the selected ancillary to the workbench.

url.title: JSON APIs: Ancillary Price API Reference
url.keywords: paid baggage, ancillary, ancillaries, buildancillaryoffersfromcatalogofferings, CatalogOfferingsIdentifier
url.description: The Ancillary Price request confirms pricing request searches for a selected ancillary. You must first create a new or post-commit workbench and send an Ancillary Shop request. After pricing, add the selected ancillary to the workbench.

url.title: JSON APIs: Ancillary Book API Reference
url.keywords: ancillary, ancillaries, paid baggage, reservationworkbench, buildancillaryoffersfromcatalogofferings
url.description: The Ancillary Book request adds a selected ancillary or a paid seat to the new or post-commit workbench.

url.title: JSON APIs: EMD Display API Reference
url.keywords: EMDNumber, EMD Number, EMD, ancillary, emddisplayvoid
url.description: Display an EMD to retrieve EMD details such as the amount paid and agency ticketing information.

url.title: JSON APIs: EMD Void API Reference
url.keywords: EMDNumber, void, EMD, emddisplayvoid, ancillary, EMDQueryUpdateEMD
url.description: Void an EMD to cancel it. You can also use EMD void with GDS Exchange Ticketing API to refund an EMD back to the FOP.

url.title: JSON APIs: Seat Map API Reference
url.keywords: catalogofferingsancillaries, seatavailabilities, seat, seats, SeatAvailabilityOfferings, CatalogOfferingsQuerySeatAvailability
url.description: The Seat Map request returns seat availability for free and paid seats.

url.title: JSON APIs: Seat Book API Reference
url.keywords: seat, seats, book seat, assign seats, buildancillaryoffersfromcatalogofferings, SeatAssignment
url.description: After retrieving available seats with a Seat Map request, you can send a Seat Book request to add a selected seat to the workbench.

url.title: JSON APIs: Seat Cancel API Reference
url.keywords: cancel seat, canceloffer, OfferQueryCancelOffer
url.description: The Seat Cancel API supports canceling free and paid seats for GDS and NDC as part of a workbench session. After canceling seats, if desired, you can select new seats in the same workbench session.

url.title: JSON APIs: Form of Payment API Reference
url.keywords: formofpayment, form of payment, FOP, credit card, cash, agent invoice, FormOfPaymentPaymentCard, PaymentCard, FormOfPaymentCash, invoice, FormOfPaymentInvoice, InvoiceNumber
url.description: You can send an Add Form of Payment (FOP) request in either a booking or ticketing workbench session. FOPs of cash and credit are supported. FOPs of agent invoice and non-standard credit card are supported for GDS only. If FOP is not sent during booking it is required during ticketing.

url.title: JSON APIs: Payment API Reference
url.keywords: payments, paymentoffer, payment, amount, FormOfPaymentIdentifier
url.description: The Add Payment step takes place in a ticketing workbench session and sends the payment. It references both the form of payment to be used for the payment and the offer to pay for. Form of payment information must already exist either in the reservation or the workbench. At workbench commit, tickets are issued for any offer for which payment has been sent.

url.title: JSON APIs: Queue API Reference
url.keywords: queue, AgencyQueue, pcc override, pccOverride, category
url.description: Prior to ticketing, you can add queue placement information to a reservation. This adds a specific agency queue to the reservation so that any additional action can be managed as necessary. Queue placement is optional after booking and before ticketing.

url.title: JSON APIs: Ticket Retrieve API Reference
url.keywords: ticketing, retrieve, ticket, reservations, booking file, retrieve ticket, retrieve booking file, ticketID
url.description: The Ticket Retrieve request returns details for a single ticket. To list ticket numbers for a single reservation, use the Ticket List request.

url.title: JSON APIs: Ticket List API Reference
url.keywords: ticketing, LocatorCode, receipt, receipts, reservations, ticket, ticket list
url.description: Send a ticket list request to return a list of all ticket numbers on a reservation.

url.title: JSON APIs: Exchange, Refund, and Void Guide
url.keywords: GDS exchanges, exchanges, void, exchange, refund, cancel, voluntary refund, manual refund, involuntary refund, automated refund
url.description: The JSON APIs support canceling GDS reservations, and voiding, exchanging, or refunding GDS tickets. This guide summarizes supported options.

url.title: JSON APIs: Ticket Void and Cancel (NDC)
url.keywords: void, cancel, NDC, refund, retain ticket value
url.description: Explains how to void a ticket and cancel a reservation.

url.title: JSON APIs: Exchange, Refund, and Void Guide
url.keywords: NDC, Air modify, modify air, exchange, exchange ticket, reprice, reshop, re-issue, reissue
url.description: This guide summarizes the options and workflows for modifying, exchanging, or canceling and refunding NDC bookings and tickets.

url.title: JSON APIs: Exchange Eligibility API Reference
url.keywords: GDS, exchange, exchanges, eligibility, ticketchangeeligibilities, ticket, locator
url.description: The Eligibility API is the first step in the GDS exchange workflow. Eligibility returns information about whether a ticket may have value in an exchange or refund scenario, and the range of potential exchange and refund fees. This information relates only to fees and not any fare or tax difference for the itinerary.

url.title: JSON APIs: Exchange Search API Reference
url.keywords: GDS exchange, exchanges, exchangesearch, catalogofferingsairchange, CatalogOfferingsQueryAirChange, CatalogOfferingsAirChangeRequest
url.description: The Exchange Search API is the second step in the GDS exchange workflow, after Eligibility. It supports searching for an alternate itinerary for a possible exchange on a currently ticketed GDS itinerary. The response details any differences in base fare, taxes, fees, and total price between the currently ticketed itinerary and the possible new itinerary.

url.title: JSON APIs: Exchange, Refund, and Void Guide
url.keywords: GDS exchange, workflows, ticket, ticket exchange, GDS, exchange, exchange ticket, buildfromcatalogofferings, OfferQueryBuildFromCatalogOfferings
url.description: Exchange Ticketing is the last step in the GDS exchange workflow, after the Exchange Search. Exchange Ticketing supports making changes to an existing GDS itinerary, and processing add collects, change fees, or refunds when applicable.

url.title: JSON APIs: Common Headers
url.keywords: authentication, credentials, PCC, headers, header fields, Accept-Encoding, Cache-Control, application/json, Content-Type, Authorization, XAUTH_TRAVELPORT_ACCESSGROUP, Accept-Version, Content-Version
url.description: Provides required and additional header fields for all Air APIs.

url.keywords: certify, JSON, JSON API, checklist, certification
url.description: To certify with any of the JSON APIs, follow this checklist and then enter a support request in your MyTravelport account.

url.keywords: Postman, credentials, test, testing
url.description: The free Postman GUI application allows you to test API requests and see examples before you add the API to your development environment.

url.title: JSON APIs: Traveler Modify Guide
url.keywords: traveler, traveller, traveler update, update traveler, JSON APIs overview, overview, getting started
url.description: Traveler information sent in the Add Traveler request can be added, modified, and deleted using the Traveler Updatable Items and Traveler Update requests. This topic details the workflow and payloads for these requests.

url.keywords: ticketing, payment, ticket, JSON APIs overview, overview, getting started
url.description: The AirTicketing API issues tickets for a held booking. This guide summarizes the required and optional steps in the ticketing workflow.

url.title: JSON APIs: Exchange, Refund, and Void Guide
url.keywords: GDS exchanges, exchange, exchanges, JSON APIs overview, overview, getting started
url.description: This guide details how to use the GDS Exchanges APIs to exchange a ticket, including support and concepts.

url.title: JSON APIs: Air Availability
url.keywords: air search, search, availability, flight search
url.description: Air Availability returns scheduled flights between a specified city pair on a specified day and time and indicates whether seats are available on those flights. Unlike the Search APIs, Air Availability focuses on seat availability by class of service. The response does not return pricing information.

url.title: JSON APIs: Fare Display API Reference
url.keywords: fare rules, fare display
url.description: The Fare Display API returns fare rule text based on the origin and destination location. This request does not require a preceding Search or AirPrice request.

url.title: JSON APIs: Host Profile Move API Reference
url.keywords: copy a profile, traveler, traveller, traveler profile
url.description: The Host Profile Move request copies traveler profile information already stored in the Travelport system into the JSON API booking workflow so that this data does not need to be re-sent.

url.title: JSON APIs: Travel Agency Corporate ID API Reference
url.keywords: travel agency, travel agency ID, agency ID
url.description: The Corporate ID request adds a travel agency corporate ID to the booking.

url.title: JSON APIs: Travel Agency Address API Reference
url.keywords: travel agency, travel agency address, address
url.description: The Corporate ID request adds a travel agency address to the booking.

url.title: JSON APIs: Ticket as FOP API Reference
url.keywords: FOP, form of payment, payment, ticket as payment, ticket form of payment
url.description: In certain scenarios, the JSON APIs support using the value on an unused ticket as form of payment (FOP) for ticketing a separate, held booking.

url.title: JSON APIs: Reservation Divide API Reference
url.keywords: reservation divide, PNR divide, split a reservation
url.description: Use the Reservation Divide API to divide a reservation with multiple travelers into separate itineraries.
